record_type_quote: In the present study, we conducted an extended replication over two years after Donald Trump’s presidential inauguration rally.

targets.title: Misinformation or expressive responding? What an inauguration crowd can tell us about the source of political misinformation in surveys.
targets.evidence_quote: In the present study we replicated the central finding of Schaffner and Luks (2018) by showing that more Republicans than Democrats provide an incorrect response when questioned about which of two photos has more people.
targets.outcome_quote: In the present study we replicated the central finding of Schaffner and Luks (2018) by showing that more Republicans than Democrats provide an incorrect response when questioned about which of two photos has more people.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The central partisan difference replicated, but the authors explicitly contrast the college-education association with the original: Indeed, the original study by Schaffner and Luks (2018) found a positive association between expressive responding and college education, but we did not. The central-finding success sentence is a particular comparison, not a verdict covering every tested finding.
